title: ADORA Penguin Soft Toy for Kids, Cute Plush Stuffed Teddy Ultra Soft Animal Plush Toy for Boys & Girls, Birthday Gift for Babies & Toddlers, Washable Black & White Penguin (17 cm)
bullets: SUPER SOFT & CUDDLY MATERIAL :- Made with premium plush fabric and soft PP cotton filling, this Adora Penguin Soft Toy is ultra-soft, skin-friendly, and perfect for hugging, cuddling, and bedtime comfort.
ADORABLE PENGUIN DESIGN :- Designed with a cute black-and-white penguin look, this plush toy instantly becomes a favorite companion for kids, toddlers, and penguin lovers of all ages.
PERFECT GIFT FOR KIDS :- An ideal gift for birthdays, return gifts, baby showers, Christmas, Children’s Day, and special occasions. Suitable for boys, girls, babies, and toddlers.
LIGHTWEIGHT & EASY TO CARRY :- Compact 17 cm size makes it easy for children to carry while traveling, sleeping, playing, or using as a decorative soft toy for bedrooms and nurseries.
SAFE & EASY TO CLEAN :- Crafted using child-safe materials with durable stitching. Easy hand wash surface keeps the plush toy clean and hygienic for everyday use.
